SPIRE1-BIG_FISH.title: Big Fish
SPIRE1-BIG_FISH.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: As you make your way down a long corridor you see a banana, a donut, and a box floating about. No... upon closer inspection they are tied to strings coming from holes in the ceiling. There is a quiet cackling from above as you approach the objects. What do you do?
SPIRE1-BIG_FISH.pages.BANANA.description: You eat the banana. It is nutritious and slightly magical, healing you.
SPIRE1-BIG_FISH.pages.DONUT.description: You eat the donut. It really hits the spot! Your Max HP increases.
SPIRE1-BIG_FISH.pages.BOX.description: You grab the box. Inside you find a relic! However, you really craved the donut... You are filled with sadness, but mostly regret.
SPIRE1-CLERIC.title: The Cleric
SPIRE1-CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.description: A strange blue humanoid with a golden helm(?) approaches you with a huge smile. "Hello friend! I am Cleric! Are you interested in my services?!" the creature shouts, loudly.
SPIRE1-CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.options.PURI: [Purify] !PurifyCost! Gold: Remove a card from your deck.
SPIRE1-CLERIC.pages.HEALED.description: A warm golden light envelops your body and dissipates. The creature grins. "Cleric best healer. Have a good day!"
SPIRE1-CLERIC.pages.PURIFIED.description: A cold blue flame envelops your body and dissipates. The creature grins. "Cleric talented. Have a good day!"
SPIRE1-CLERIC.pages.LEAVE.description: You don't trust this "Cleric", so you leave.
SPIRE1-DEAD_ADVENTURER.title: Dead Adventurer
SPIRE1-DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.INITIAL.des: You come across a dead adventurer on the floor. His pants have been stolen! Also, {Flavor} Though his possessions are still intact, you're in no mind to find out what happened here...
SPIRE1-DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.FIGHT.descr: While searching the adventurer you are caught off guard!
SPIRE1-DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.GOLD.descri: You found some gold! Continue searching?
SPIRE1-DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.NOTHING.des: Hmm, couldn't find anything... Continue searching?
SPIRE1-DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.RELIC.descr: You found a relic! Continue searching?
SPIRE1-DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.SUCCESS.des: Looks like you searched all his belongings without a hitch!
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_IDOL_EVENT.title: Golden Idol
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_IDOL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.d: You come across an inconspicuous pedestal with a shining gold idol sitting peacefully atop. It looks incredibly valuable. You sure don't see any traps nearby.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_IDOL_EVENT.pages.BOULDER.d: As you grab the Idol and stow it away, a giant boulder smashes through the ceiling into the ground next to you. You realize that the floor is slanted downwards as the boulder starts to roll towards you.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_IDOL_EVENT.pages.CHOSE_RUN: RUUUUUUUUUUN! You barely leap into a side passageway as the boulder rushes by. Unfortunately it feels like you sprained something however.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_IDOL_EVENT.pages.CHOSE_FIG: You throw yourself at the boulder with everything you have. When the dust clears, you can make a safe way out.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_IDOL_EVENT.pages.CHOSE_FLA: SQUISH! The boulder flattens you a little as it passes by, but otherwise you can get out of here.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_IDOL_EVENT.pages.IGNORE.de: If there was ever an obvious trap, this would be it. You decide not to interfere with objects placed upon pedestals.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_WING.title: Wing Statue
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_WING.pages.INITIAL.descrip: Among the stone and boulders, you notice an intricate large blue statue resembling a wing. You find gold spilling from its cracks. Maybe there is more inside...
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_WING.pages.INITIAL.options: [Pray] Remove a card from your deck. Lose 7 HP.
[Locked] Requires: Card with 10 or more damage.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_WING.pages.PRAYED.descript: Someone once told you of a cult that worshipped a giant bird. As you kneel in prayer, you begin to feel ... lightheaded . You wake up some time later, feeling strangely fleet of foot.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_WING.pages.DESTROYED.descr: With all your might, you hack away at the statue. It soon crumbles, revealing a pile of gold. You grab as much as you can and continue onwards.
SPIRE1-GOLDEN_WING.pages.LEFT.descriptio: The statue makes you feel uneasy. You walk past and continue onward.
SPIRE1-GOOP_PUDDLE.title: World of Goop
SPIRE1-GOOP_PUDDLE.pages.INITIAL.descrip: You fall into a puddle. IT'S MADE OF SLIME GOOP!! Frantically, you claw yourself out over several minutes as you feel the goop starting to burn. You can feel goop in your ears, goop in your nose, goop everywhere. Climbing out, you notice that some of your gold is missing. Looking back to the puddle you see your missing coins combined with gold from unfortunate adventurers mixed together in the puddle.
SPIRE1-GOOP_PUDDLE.pages.GATHERED.descri: Feeling the sting of the goop as the prolonged exposure starts to melt away at your skin, you manage to fish out the gold.
SPIRE1-GOOP_PUDDLE.pages.LEFT.descriptio: You decide that mess is not worth it.
SPIRE1-LIVING_WALL.title: Living Wall
SPIRE1-LIVING_WALL.pages.INITIAL.descrip: As you come to a dead-end and begin to turn around, walls slam down from the ceiling, trapping you! Three faces materialize from the walls and speak. "Forget what you know, and I'll let you go." "I require change to see a new space." "If you want to pass me, then you must grow."
SPIRE1-LIVING_WALL.pages.INITIAL.options: [Forget] Remove a card from your deck.
[Change] Transform a card in your deck.
[Grow] Upgrade a card in your deck.
SPIRE1-LIVING_WALL.pages.RESULT.descript: Satisfied, the walls in front of you merge back into the ceiling, leaving a path forward.
SPIRE1-MUSHROOMS.title: Mushrooms
SPIRE1-MUSHROOMS.pages.INITIAL.descripti: You enter a corridor full of hypnotizing colored mushrooms. Due to your lack of specialization in mycology you are unable to identify the specimens. You want to escape, but feel oddly compelled to eat a mushroom...
SPIRE1-MUSHROOMS.pages.HEALED.descriptio: You give in to the unnatural desire to eat. As you consume mushroom after mushroom, you feel yourself entering into a daze and pass out. As you awake, you feel very odd. You Heal 25% of your HP, but you also get infected.
SPIRE1-SCRAP_OOZE.title: Scrap Ooze
SPIRE1-SCRAP_OOZE.pages.INITIAL.descript: As you walk into the room you hear a gurgling and the grinding of metals. Before you is a slime-like creature that ate too much scrap for its own good. From the center of the creature you see glints of strange light, perhaps something magical? It looks like you can get some treasure if you just reach inside its... opening. However, the acid and sharp objects may hurt.
[Reach Inside] Lose !Damage! HP. !Chance!%: Find a Relic.
SPIRE1-SCRAP_OOZE.pages.FAIL.description: Ouch! All you find is corroded metal and a bit of burning pain. However, you're still convinced there's a relic...
SPIRE1-SCRAP_OOZE.pages.SUCCESS.descript: Success! After rummaging through the metal and burning acid, you finally grab hold of a relic and yank it out. You pull your way out of the ooze damaged but rewarded.
SPIRE1-SCRAP_OOZE.pages.ESCAPE.descripti: You decide to leave the area. The slime pays no attention, content with its meal.
SPIRE1-SHINING_LIGHT.title: Shining Light
SPIRE1-SHINING_LIGHT.pages.INITIAL.descr: You find a shimmering mass of light encompassing the center of the room. Its warm glow and enchanting patterns invite you in.
SPIRE1-SHINING_LIGHT.pages.ENTERED.descr: As you walk through the light, you notice that the light is absorbed into you. It's scorching hot! However, the pain quickly recedes. You feel invigorated, as though you received a well deserved slap.
SPIRE1-SHINING_LIGHT.pages.LEFT.descript: You walk around it, wondering what could have been.
SPIRE1-SSSSERPENT.title: The Ssssserpent
SPIRE1-SSSSERPENT.pages.INITIAL.descript: You walk into a room to find a large hole in the ground. As you approach the hole, an enormous serpent creature appears from within. "Ho hooo! Hello hello! what have we got here? Hello adventurer, I ask a simple question. The most fulfilling of lives is that in which you can buy anything! Do you agree?"
SPIRE1-SSSSERPENT.pages.AGREE.descriptio: "Yeeeeeeessssssssssessss! Thisss will all be worthhh it. ..ssSSs..... ss... sssss....!"
SPIRE1-SSSSERPENT.pages.DISAGREE.descrip: The serpent stares at you with a look of extreme disappointment.
SPIRE1-SSSSERPENT.pages.GOLD_RAIN.descri: The serpent rears its head and blasts a stream of gold upwards! It is amazing and terrifying simultaneously. You gather all the gold, thank the snake, and get going.
SPIRE1-ADDICT.title: Pleading Vagrant
SPIRE1-ADDICT.pages.INITIAL.description: While sneaking past a group of shrouded figures, one of them approaches you. "Got anything for me friend? Please... maybe some Coin?" "I just need somewhere to stay, I have treasures I can trade..." He seems delusional, but harmless.
[Rob] Obtain a Relic. Become Cursed - Shame.
SPIRE1-ADDICT.pages.OFFER.description: Oh yes, yes! Here here, a fair trade!
SPIRE1-ADDICT.pages.ROB.description: You snatch the precious relic from his clutches and walk away. From behind you hear, "Have you no shame? HAVE YOU NO SHAAAAAME?!" You have some shame.
SPIRE1-BACK_TO_BASICS.title: Ancient Writing
SPIRE1-BACK_TO_BASICS.pages.INITIAL.desc: Scaling the city, you notice a wall covered in the writing of Ancients. As you try to wrap your head around what the puzzling symbols and glyphs could mean, the writing begins to glow. Suddenly, the message becomes clear...
SPIRE1-BACK_TO_BASICS.pages.INITIAL.opti: [Elegance] Remove a card from your deck.
SPIRE1-BACK_TO_BASICS.pages.ELEGANCE.des: The answer was elegance. Of course.
SPIRE1-BEGGAR.title: Old Beggar
SPIRE1-BEGGAR.pages.INITIAL.description: An old beggar cloaked in fur reaches his hands out towards you as you pass. "Spare some coin, child?"
SPIRE1-BEGGAR.pages.INITIAL.options.OFFE: [Offer Gold] !Gold! Gold: Remove a card from your deck.
SPIRE1-BEGGAR.pages.PURGE.description: The beggar takes off its cloak to reveal that he is Cleric! "You are a kind soul. Receive my purification!" he screams. You are unsure if he is grateful or mad.
SPIRE1-BEGGAR.pages.POST_PURGE.descripti: "I hope you do better this time, friend!" he shouts. Wondering what was implied by this, you push forward.
SPIRE1-BEGGAR.pages.LEAVE.description: The beggar looks to the floor as you pass. "You will never make a difference... You never do."
SPIRE1-COLOSSEUM.title: The Colosseum
SPIRE1-COLOSSEUM.pages.FIGHT.description: Groggy and with a throbbing head, you awaken to find yourself thrown in the center of a massive stadium with an overflowing audience of Slavers, Cultists, and other denizens of the City! An armored giant with a golden crown bellows at you from atop, "WE NOW BEGIN THE 4200TH COMBAT!!!!" A gate on the opposite side opens...
SPIRE1-COLOSSEUM.pages.FIGHT.options.FIG: Requires: StS1 encounter "Colosseum Slavers" (not yet ported).
SPIRE1-CURSED_TOME.title: Cursed Tome
SPIRE1-CURSED_TOME.pages.INITIAL.descrip: In an abandoned temple, you find a giant book, open, riddled with cryptic writings. As you try to interpret the elaborate script, it begins to shift and morph into writing you are familiar with.
SPIRE1-CURSED_TOME.pages.PAGE_1.descript: Odd. The book seems to be about an Ancient named Neow. This piques your interest, but you have a general feeling of malaise.
SPIRE1-CURSED_TOME.pages.PAGE_2.descript: The Ancient of Resurrection, Neow, was exiled to the bottom of the Spire. You feel compelled to read more, but your body begins to ache.
SPIRE1-CURSED_TOME.pages.PAGE_3.descript: Seeking vengeance, Neow blesses outsiders, using them for her own purposes. You are starting to feel very weak and tired...
SPIRE1-CURSED_TOME.pages.LAST_PAGE.descr: Those resurrected by Neow remember only fragments of their past selves, cursed to fight for eternity. As you near the final page, your old wounds begin to reopen!
SPIRE1-CURSED_TOME.pages.OBTAIN.descript: Upon finishing the tome, you decide to take it with you. With proof in hand, will you retain your memories?
SPIRE1-CURSED_TOME.pages.STOP.descriptio: With incredible strain and willpower, you resist the trance of the tome and SLAM it shut. You turn and exit the temple, feeling drained...
SPIRE1-CURSED_TOME.pages.IGNORE.descript: You exit, feeling a dark energy emanating from the book on the pedestal.
SPIRE1-DRUG_DEALER.title: Augmenter
SPIRE1-DRUG_DEALER.pages.INITIAL.descrip: A man with an eyepatch and a devilish grin strides up to you. "Hey there, stranger. Interested in advancing science? I can make you stronger than any training or blessing. You're gonna need it if you're one of those heroes with a death wish." "Whad'ya say?"
SPIRE1-DRUG_DEALER.pages.INITIAL.options: [Locked] Requires: 2 or more cards in deck.
SPIRE1-DRUG_DEALER.pages.TRANSFORM.descr: "Superb." The man injects you with three unknown substances and pulls out a notepad. As you begin to feel light-headed, he starts to frantically write down notes. Losing track of time completely, by the time you regain your senses, the shady character has disappeared.
SPIRE1-FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.title: Forgotten Altar
SPIRE1-FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.INITIAL.des: In front of you sits an altar to a forgotten god. Atop the altar sits an ornate female statue with arms outstretched. She calls out to you, demanding sacrifice.
SPIRE1-FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.IDOL.descri: As you gently set the idol onto the altar a cold wind swirls throughout the room. The arms of the statue begin to discolor and crumble. Your golden idol begins to dull in color and begins bleeding from its eyes. The bleeding never ceases.
SPIRE1-FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.SACRIFICE.d: You stand on the altar and cut your wrists. As the blood spills out in sacrifice, the arms of the statue reach out and close around your eyes. Everything goes dark. You wake up a short time later feeling a new potential surging through you.
SPIRE1-FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.DESECRATE.d: You lash out and smash the statue in front of you, breaking the magical hold the room had placed upon you. A dark wail echoes all around you, and you can feel the cursed magic seep into your bones.
SPIRE1-GHOSTS.title: Council of Ghosts
SPIRE1-GHOSTS.pages.INITIAL.description: As you continue your ascent, thick black smoke begins to billow out of the ground and walls around you, coalescing into three masked forms that start to speak. "Another puppet of Neow I think." "AGREED! SHE ALWAYS MAKES THE FUNNEST TOYS!" You notice an over-sized grin as the third addresses you. "Ignore the others... Would you like a taste of our power?"
SPIRE1-GHOSTS.pages.ACCEPT.description: "Excellent!" As the ghostly shape speaks, you notice its large mouth opening wider and wider. Thick black smoke spews forth and envelops the room. You cannot see or breathe... Just before you lose consciousness, the sensation stops. Whatever those things were, they are gone now. You continue on, feeling rather hollow.
SPIRE1-GHOSTS.pages.EXIT.description: "How disappointing..." "You will join us sooner or later." "HA HA HA HAHAHA!" The shapes fade away, leaving only the unnerving laughter ringing in your ears.
SPIRE1-KNOWING_SKULL.title: Knowing Skull
SPIRE1-KNOWING_SKULL.pages.INITIAL.descr: You find yourself in an old, decorated chamber. In the center of the room, a large skull sits atop an ornate pedestal. As you approach, the skull bursts into flames and turns to face you.
SPIRE1-KNOWING_SKULL.pages.ASK.descripti: "WHAT IS IT YOU SEEK? WHAT IS IT YOU OFFER?" In sync with its final words, the door behind you slams shut.
SPIRE1-KNOWING_SKULL.pages.ASK.options.P: [A Pick Me Up?] Get a Potion. Lose !PotionCost! HP.
SPIRE1-KNOWING_SKULL.pages.ASK.options.C: [Success?] Get a Colorless Card. Lose !CardCost! HP.
SPIRE1-KNOWING_SKULL.pages.POTION.descri: "DRINK UP!" You obtain a potion. "ANYTHING ELSE?"
SPIRE1-KNOWING_SKULL.pages.GOLD.descript: "YOU MORTALS NEVER CHANGE. IT IS DONE." Gold rains down on you! "ANYTHING ELSE?"
SPIRE1-KNOWING_SKULL.pages.CARD.descript: "PERHAPS THIS WILL HELP?" You obtain a card. "ANYTHING ELSE?"
SPIRE1-KNOWING_SKULL.pages.LEAVE.descrip: "BEHIND YOU, MORTAL." You peek behind the skull. Surely enough, there is a door.
SPIRE1-MASKED_BANDITS.title: Masked Bandits
SPIRE1-MASKED_BANDITS.pages.INITIAL.desc: You encounter a group of bandits wearing large red masks. "Hello, pay up to pass... a reasonable fee of ALL your Gold will do! Heh heh!"
SPIRE1-MASKED_BANDITS.pages.INITIAL.opti: Requires: StS1 encounter "Masked Bandits" (not yet ported).
SPIRE1-MASKED_BANDITS.pages.PAID_1.descr: Hehehe.. Thanks for the gold! Oh, I love gold. It's so nice. shiny shiny chits they are!
SPIRE1-MASKED_BANDITS.pages.PAID_2.descr: Hey Bear, hey! This guy gave us all his gold! What a sucker, right? Get this, I just had to ask nicely. Who knew?! I certainly didn't! What a chump!
SPIRE1-MASKED_BANDITS.pages.PAID_3.descr: Gang, let's all have a laugh for this wondrous occasion! Hahaah Ho HOH hoho! Hoh!
SPIRE1-MASKED_BANDITS.pages.PAID_4.descr: Oh? You're still here? Did you overhear something? Didn't think so. *snerk* ...loser.... Hahaha haaah
SPIRE1-NEST.title: The Nest
SPIRE1-NEST.pages.INITIAL.description: A long line of hooded figures can be seen entering an unassuming cathedral.
SPIRE1-NEST.pages.CHOICE.description: Naturally, you join the line and are quickly surrounded by Cultists! They ignore you as they gleefully chant and wave their weapons around. "MURDER!! MURDER MURDER!!" "CAW CAW CAAAAAWWW!" "MURDER! MURDER MUURDER!!" "CAAW CAW CAAAAAAWW!!" You eye a Donation Box...
SPIRE1-NEST.pages.CHOICE.options.STAY_IN: [Stay in Line] Obtain Ritual Dagger. Lose 6 HP.
SPIRE1-NEST.pages.ACCEPT.description: You decide to stay in line (out of fear) to see what will happen. Eventually, you are face-to-face with the leader. A well-dressed cultist hands you an Ornate Dagger. Like the others before you, you slash your forearm and let the blood drip into a misshapen bowl. The cultists chant and holler for you! "CAAW CAW CAAAAAAWW!!" You chant, too. Why not?
SPIRE1-THE_JOUST.title: The Joust
SPIRE1-THE_JOUST.pages.INITIAL.descripti: As you make your way through the large buildings you come across a long narrow bridge and spot knights on either side, facing one another. You approach... "Halt!" A knight forcefully gestures you to stop with its giant lance.
SPIRE1-THE_JOUST.pages.EXPLANATION.descr: "Today is the day I must settle the score with the murderer of my beloved pet, Noodles. Until then, you may not pass. Fellow witness, why don't you bet on who you think will emerge victorious?"
SPIRE1-THE_JOUST.pages.BET_AGAINST.descr: "I can't believe you're betting against Noodles!" Furious, he clamps down his helmet and rushes towards his nemesis.
SPIRE1-THE_JOUST.pages.BET_FOR.descripti: "Give me strength, Noodles!" Clamping down his helmet, the knight charges forward.
SPIRE1-THE_JOUST.pages.NEMESIS_SLAIN_BET: The nemesis was slain. You win the bet. Unsure what to think, you grab your winnings and leave.
The nemesis was slain. You lost the bet, but at least you weren't gouged by a lance.
SPIRE1-THE_JOUST.pages.OWNER_DIED_BET_WO: The owner died. You win the bet. Unsure what to think, you grab your winnings and leave.
SPIRE1-THE_JOUST.pages.OWNER_DIED_BET_LO: The owner died. You lost the bet, but at least you weren't gouged by a lance.
SPIRE1-THE_LIBRARY.title: The Library
SPIRE1-THE_LIBRARY.pages.INITIAL.descrip: You come across an ornate building which appears abandoned. A plaque that has been torn free from a wall is on the floor. It reads, "THE LIBRARY". Inside, you find countless rows of scrolls, manuscripts, and books. You pick one and cozy yourself into a chair for some quiet time.
SPIRE1-THE_LIBRARY.pages.INITIAL.options: [Read] Choose 1 of 20 cards to add to your deck.
SPIRE1-THE_LIBRARY.pages.SLEEP.descripti: Reading is for chumps. You doze off in a comfy chair instead. Zzz... zzz... ..Zz.... You wake up feeling refreshed.
SPIRE1-THE_LIBRARY.pages.BOOK_1.descript: The story is about an insect-controlling teenage girl who aspires to become a hero. The book is filled with creative uses of powers, combat strategies, and varying perspectives. Satisfying.
SPIRE1-THE_LIBRARY.pages.BOOK_2.descript: The story is about a man who journeyed beyond the stars and found himself stuck on a desolate foreign planet. Ingenuity, luck, perseverance, and humor to retain his sanity were his tools to return home. Fascinating.
SPIRE1-THE_LIBRARY.pages.BOOK_3.descript: The story takes place in a giant isolated building underground as the outside conditions have become unbearable. The novel is mired with conspiracies, propaganda, and injustice. You ponder if similar dynamics are at play within the Spire. Unsettling.
SPIRE1-THE_LIBRARY.pages.READ.selectionS: Add a card to your deck.
SPIRE1-THE_MAUSOLEUM.title: The Mausoleum
SPIRE1-THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.INITIAL.descr: Venturing through a series of tombs, you are faced with a large sarcophagus studded with gems in the center of a circular room. You cannot make out the writing on the coffin, however, you do notice black fog seeping out from the sides.
SPIRE1-THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.INITIAL.optio: [Open Coffin] Obtain a Relic. !Percent!%: Become Cursed - Writhe.
SPIRE1-THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.CURSED.descri: You push open the coffin. As you do, black fog spews forth and covers the entire room! Inside, you find no body, only a relic. You take it and move onwards, coughing violently.
SPIRE1-THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.NORMAL.descri: You push open the coffin. The fog dissipates harmlessly. Inside, you find the mortal remains of a decorated soldier grasping an old relic. You pilfer it and move on.
SPIRE1-THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.NOPE.descript: You continue along your way, leaving the forgotten dead undisturbed.
SPIRE1-VAMPIRES.title: Vampires(?)
SPIRE1-VAMPIRES.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: Navigating an unlit street, you come across several hooded figures in the midst of some dark ritual. As you approach, they turn to you in eerie unison. The tallest among them bares fanged teeth and extends a long, pale hand towards you. "Join us brother, and feel the warmth of the Spire."
SPIRE1-VAMPIRES.pages.INITIAL_F.descript: Navigating an unlit street, you come across several hooded figures in the midst of some dark ritual. As you approach, they turn to you in eerie unison. The tallest among them bares fanged teeth and extends a long, pale hand towards you. "Join us sister, and feel the warmth of the Spire."
SPIRE1-VAMPIRES.pages.INITIAL_N.descript: Navigating an unlit street, you come across several hooded figures in the midst of some dark ritual. As you approach, they turn to you in eerie unison. The tallest among them bares fanged teeth and extends a long, pale hand towards you. "Join us broken one, and feel the warmth of the Spire."
SPIRE1-VAMPIRES.pages.INITIAL.options.AC: [Accept] Remove all Strikes. Receive 5 Bites. Lose !MaxHpLoss! Max HP.
SPIRE1-VAMPIRES.pages.INITIAL.options.LO: [Lose Blood Vial] Remove all Strikes. Receive 5 Bites.
SPIRE1-VAMPIRES.pages.ACCEPT.description: The tall figure grabs your arm, pulls you forward, and sinks his fangs into your neck. You feel a dark force pour into your neck and course through your body. ... You wake up some time later, alone. An intense hunger passes through your belly. You must feed...
SPIRE1-VAMPIRES.pages.VIAL.description: The pale figures gasp as you take out the Blood Vial. "The master's blood... the master's blood! THE MASTER'S BLOOD!" They all chant fervently as the tall one bows before you. "Drink from His blood, and become one with Him." The chant growing louder, you consume the contents of the vial. Your vision immediately warps and fades to darkness. You wake up some time later, alone. An intense hunger passes through your belly. You must feed.
SPIRE1-VAMPIRES.pages.EXIT.description: You step back and raise your weapon in defiance. The tall figure sighs. "Very well." The entire group of hooded figures morph into a thick black fog that flows away from you. You are alone once more.
SPIRE1-FALLING.title: Falling
SPIRE1-FALLING.pages.INITIAL.description: As you head upwards hopping from one floating shape to another, you slip. You begin to fall.
SPIRE1-FALLING.pages.CHOICE.description: While in free fall you consider your options: Land safely with your greatest techniques. Channel a Power to survive the fall. Strike at the wall to hang on to it.
SPIRE1-FALLING.pages.LAND.description: You land with extreme grace before continuing on.
SPIRE1-FALLING.pages.CHANNEL.description: Harnessing and expending some of your raw power, you manage to land unhurt.
SPIRE1-FALLING.pages.STRIKE.description: You are able to latch on to the wall, and manage to make a short hop onto another stable platform.
SPIRE1-FALLING.pages.FEATHER.description: You seem to fall as slow as a feather, reaching the bottom without a scratch.
SPIRE1-MIND_BLOOM.title: Mind Bloom
SPIRE1-MIND_BLOOM.pages.INITIAL.descript: While walking and traversing through the chaos of the Spire, your thoughts suddenly begin to feel very... real... Imaginings of monsters and riches begin to manifest themselves into reality. The sensation is quickly fleeting. What do you do?
Upgrade all Cards. You can no longer heal.
Heal to full HP. Cursed - Doubt.
SPIRE1-MIND_BLOOM.pages.AWAKE.descriptio: Everything makes sense now. The lack of memories, the ascent, the Ancient One. This is the way it always was. This is the way it always will be. All will be forgotten again soon...
SPIRE1-MIND_BLOOM.pages.RICH.description: Can it really be this easy?
SPIRE1-MIND_BLOOM.pages.HEALTHY.descript: Can it really be this easy?
SPIRE1-MOAI_HEAD.title: The Moai Head
SPIRE1-MOAI_HEAD.pages.INITIAL.descripti: You stumble across something that feels *very* out of place. Before you, an enormous stony head emerges from a large wall segment that does not shift and change like the rest of this area. The head's mouth is wide open, and it reveals large intimidating teeth stained red with blood. The surface of the statue is riddled with pictographs that seem to indicate people throwing themselves into the mouth of this head and being devoured. Why would anyone do that?
SPIRE1-MOAI_HEAD.pages.INITIAL.options.J: Heal to full HP. Lose !HpLoss! Max HP.
SPIRE1-MOAI_HEAD.pages.JUMP.description: At first when you step up into the mouth of the statue, nothing happens. As you start to feel more than a little foolish, the huge molars slam down from above, crushing you whole. Darkness. Sometime later from within the dark, you see a sliver of light, and hear what you now realize is the sound of stony teeth slowly rising upwards. You leave confused.
SPIRE1-MOAI_HEAD.pages.LEAVE.description: You leave, wondering what could have been.
SPIRE1-MYSTERIOUS_SPHERE.title: Mysterious Sphere
SPIRE1-MYSTERIOUS_SPHERE.pages.INITIAL.d: Jutting from the chaotic terrain around you, a bony sphere surrounds a mysterious glowing object within. While you are curious what lies inside, you notice some sentries keeping an eye on it.
SPIRE1-SECRET_PORTAL.title: Secret Portal
SPIRE1-SECRET_PORTAL.pages.INITIAL.descr: Before you is a sight that seems out of place in the alien landscape around you. Strangely placed into one of the living walls of the Beyond is an enclosed stone entrance filled with a swirling magical portal. You aren't sure where it leads, but maybe it could speed your journey through the Spire.
SPIRE1-SECRET_PORTAL.pages.LEAVE.descrip: Careful and cautious seems the better approach for reaching the top of the Spire. Ignoring the portal you continue on.
SPIRE1-SENSORY_STONE.title: Sensory Stone
SPIRE1-SENSORY_STONE.pages.INITIAL.descr: Navigating through the Beyond, you discover a glowing tesseract spinning and shifting gently in the air.
SPIRE1-SENSORY_STONE.pages.CHOICE.descri: You touch it. A sharp pain flows through you, followed by vivid flashes of a distant memory. ...whose memories are these?
SPIRE1-SENSORY_STONE.pages.CHOICE.option: Add 1 Colorless card to your deck.
Add 2 Colorless cards to your deck. Lose 5 HP.
Add 3 Colorless cards to your deck. Lose 10 HP.
SPIRE1-SENSORY_STONE.pages.MEMORY_1.desc: FEAR. A demonic creature towers above you, wings spread wide as it howls with laughter. Dead bodies of a tribe surround you while the village is engulfed in terrible dark flames. The demon calls out, taunting you. " YOU REALLY ARE THE STRONGEST NOW! Haha.. HEHE... HAHAHAAAAH!! " This laughter echoes forever...
SPIRE1-SENSORY_STONE.pages.MEMORY_2.desc: TRIUMPH. The remains of a ghostly creature sink slowly into the mud before you, barely visible in the moonlight. You have proven yourself amongst your sisters. Standing victoriously, you wait in silence as the others ceremoniously place the creature's skull atop your head. The ritual has concluded. You head towards the Spire...
SPIRE1-SENSORY_STONE.pages.MEMORY_3.desc: CONFUSION. [OBJECTIVE] BALANCE must be ENFORCED [DEFINE] BALANCE [ERROR] BALANCE NOT FOUND [DEFINE] BALANCE [ERROR] BALANCE NOT FOUND [WARNING] Large object approaching "I... ..am ....Neow.."
SPIRE1-SENSORY_STONE.pages.MEMORY_4.desc: SERENITY. Two primitive creatures fight over a carcass on the side of the road. You observe, devoid of emotion. Watch. Remember. Live. This is the Watcher's mission. Recently, one of your peers had stopped reporting on their assignment: a Spire of unknown origin. As the fight ends, you continue onward, unfazed by the bloody scene that took place.
SPIRE1-SPIRE_HEART.title: Spire Heart
SPIRE1-SPIRE_HEART.pages.INITIAL.descrip: tu-thump ... tu-thump ... tu-thump ... A deep pulsing dread can be felt throughout the room... Is this the heart of the Spire? The source of this evil?
SPIRE1-SPIRE_HEART.pages.MIDDLE_CORE.des: You charge your core to its maximum...
SPIRE1-SPIRE_HEART.pages.MIDDLE_STAFF.de: You prime your staff with divine energy...
SPIRE1-SPIRE_HEART.pages.MIDDLE_2.descri: You deal !DamageDealt! damage! The heart squirms and bleeds ...but is ultimately still pounding. Are your mightiest attacks not enough?
SPIRE1-SPIRE_HEART.pages.DEATH.descripti: You ask yourself, "Have I been here before?" The heart pulses louder and louder as your consciousness fades...
SPIRE1-TOMB_RED_MASK.title: Tomb of Lord Red Mask
SPIRE1-TOMB_RED_MASK.pages.INITIAL.descr: A highly ornamented tomb can be seen on the other side of a floating path. Upon reaching the tomb, you notice a slot for gold coins with a scratched out inscription above it.
SPIRE1-WINDING_HALLS.title: Winding Halls
SPIRE1-WINDING_HALLS.pages.INITIAL.descr: As you slowly make your way up the twisting pathways, you constantly find yourself losing your way as the walls and ground seem to inexplicably shift before your eyes. The constant whispering voices in the back of your head aren't helping things either.
SPIRE1-WINDING_HALLS.pages.CHOICE.descri: Passing by a structure you are certain you have previously seen you start to question if you are going insane, or if the impossible geography of this place is starting to get to you. You need to change something, and soon. That's what the voices say anyway, and why would they lie?
SPIRE1-WINDING_HALLS.pages.MADNESS.descr: Something in you cracks. Only the truly mad can understand a place like this, so you give into the chattering voices and continue on with a "new" perspective. Things do seem to make so much more sense now.
SPIRE1-WINDING_HALLS.pages.FOCUS.descrip: As you take a moment to stop and carefully observe the undulating landscape around you, the hint of a pattern starts to emerge from within the randomness. Whenever the demented noises begin to interrupt your thoughts, you struggle through the mental pain and ignore it. Eventually you successfully map out a path forward, and continue on, now resistant to the nefarious nature of this alien place.
SPIRE1-WINDING_HALLS.pages.RETRACE.descr: You spend what seems like an eternity lost in the maze. Slowly but surely, you are able to retrace your steps, reorient yourself, and make it out of the twisting passages. You feel drained from the experience.
SPIRE1-ACCURSED_BLACKSMITH.title: Ominous Forge
SPIRE1-ACCURSED_BLACKSMITH.pages.INITIAL: You duck into a small hut. Inside, you find what appears to be a forge. The smithing tools are covered with dust, yet a fire roars inside the furnace. You feel on edge...
[Forge] Upgrade a card in your deck.
SPIRE1-ACCURSED_BLACKSMITH.pages.FORGE.d: You decide to put the forge to use and... CLANG CLAAANG CLANG! ...improve your arsenal!
SPIRE1-ACCURSED_BLACKSMITH.pages.LEAVE.d: There doesn't seem to be anything of use. You exit the way you came, the flames of the furnace casting eerie shadows on the walls inside the hut...
SPIRE1-BONFIRE.title: Bonfire Spirits
SPIRE1-BONFIRE.pages.INITIAL.description: You happen upon a group of what looks like purple fire spirits dancing around a large bonfire.
SPIRE1-BONFIRE.pages.INTRO.description: The spirits toss small bones and fragments into the fire, which brilliantly erupts each time. As you approach, the spirits all turn to you, expectantly...
SPIRE1-BONFIRE.pages.INTRO.options.OFFER: [Offer] Receive a reward based on the offer.
SPIRE1-BONFIRE.pages.NOTHING.description: You toss an offering into the bonfire. Nothing happens... The spirits seem to be ignoring you now. Disappointing...
SPIRE1-BONFIRE.pages.HEAL.description: You toss an offering into the bonfire. The flames grow slightly brighter. The spirits continue dancing. You feel slightly warmer from their presence.. You heal 5 HP.
SPIRE1-BONFIRE.pages.FULL_HEAL.descripti: You toss an offering into the bonfire. The flames erupt, growing significantly stronger! The spirits dance around you excitedly, filling you with a sense of warmth. You are healed to full HP.
SPIRE1-BONFIRE.pages.GREAT.description: You toss an offering into the bonfire. The flames burst, nearly knocking you off your feet, as the fire doubles in strength. The spirits dance around you excitedly before merging into your form, filling you with warmth and strength. Your Max HP increases by 10 and you are healed to full HP.
SPIRE1-DESIGNER.title: Designer In-Spire
SPIRE1-DESIGNER.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: You discover a colorful shop with the banner "IN-SPIRE" and walk in to see what's inside. "No, no way. Nope. Can't let you in!" A man with ridiculous clothing appears at the entrance to bar you.
SPIRE1-DESIGNER.pages.MAIN.description: "This will not do, no no. What is this style? Disgusting! Are you bleeeeding? Groooss. Business?? You a customer? Fine. Whaaatever." He lets out an exaggerated sigh and points at a list of services. The services seem fine, but you would rather punch this smug man in his smug face.
SPIRE1-DESIGNER.pages.MAIN.options.CLEAN: [Clean Up] Lose !CleanUpCost! Gold. Remove a card.
SPIRE1-DESIGNER.pages.MAIN.options.FULL_: [Full Service] Lose !FullServiceCost! Gold. Remove a card and upgrade a random card.
SPIRE1-DESIGNER.pages.PUNCHED.descriptio: You punch him so hard your fist hurts. "My FACE!! Now I'll have to-" He fainted. Who's groooss and bleeeeding now?
SPIRE1-DUPLICATOR.title: Duplicator
SPIRE1-DUPLICATOR.pages.INITIAL.descript: Before you lies a decorated altar to some ancient entity.
[Pray] Duplicate a card in your deck.
SPIRE1-DUPLICATOR.pages.DONE.description: You kneel respectfully. A ghastly mirror image appears from the shrine and collides into you.
SPIRE1-DUPLICATOR.pages.IGNORE.descripti: You ignore the shrine, confident in your choice.
SPIRE1-FACE_TRADER.title: Face Trader
SPIRE1-FACE_TRADER.pages.INITIAL.descrip: You walk by an eerie statue holding several masks... Something behind you softly whispers, "Stop."
SPIRE1-FACE_TRADER.pages.MAIN.descriptio: You swerve around to face the statue which is now facing you! On closer inspection, it's not a statue but a statuesque, gaunt man. Is he even breathing? "Face. Let me touch? Maybe trade?"
SPIRE1-FACE_TRADER.pages.TOUCH.descripti: "Compensation? Compensation." Mechanically, he cranes out a neat stack of gold and places it into your pouch. "What a nice face. Nice face." While he touches your face, you begin to feel your life drain out of it! During this, his mask falls off and shatters. Screaming, he quickly covers his face with all six arms dropping even more masks! Amidst all the screaming and shattering, you escape. His face was completely blank.
SPIRE1-FACE_TRADER.pages.LEAVE.descripti: "Stop. Stop. Stop. Stop. Stop." This was probably the right call.
SPIRE1-FOUNTAIN_OF_CURSE_REMOVAL.title: The Divine Fountain
SPIRE1-FOUNTAIN_OF_CURSE_REMOVAL.pages.I: You come across shimmering water flowing endlessly from a fountain on a nearby wall.
[Drink] Remove all Curses from your deck.
SPIRE1-FOUNTAIN_OF_CURSE_REMOVAL.pages.D: As you drink the water, you feel a dark grasp loosen.
SPIRE1-FOUNTAIN_OF_CURSE_REMOVAL.pages.L: Unsure of the nature of this water, you continue on your way, parched.
SPIRE1-GOLD_SHRINE.title: Golden Shrine
SPIRE1-GOLD_SHRINE.pages.INITIAL.descrip: Before you lies an elaborate shrine to an ancient spirit.
SPIRE1-GOLD_SHRINE.pages.PRAY.descriptio: As your hand touches the shrine, gold rains from the ceiling showering you in riches.
SPIRE1-GOLD_SHRINE.pages.DESECRATE.descr: Each time you strike the shrine, gold pours forth again and again! As you pocket the riches, something weighs heavily on you.
SPIRE1-GREMLIN_MATCH_GAME.title: Match and Keep!
A gremlin is madly shuffling cards on a table. This monster seems to be a harmless one. You approach him out of curiosity.
SPIRE1-GREMLIN_MATCH_GAME.pages.RULES.de: " Twelve cards! Match them to keep them! Five tries, no do-overs. Are you ready? Let's start!"
SPIRE1-GREMLIN_MATCH_GAME.pages.COMPLETE: You complete the gremlin's game and look up. He disappeared?
SPIRE1-GREMLIN_WHEEL_GAME.title: Wheel of Change
You come upon a dapper looking, cheery gremlin. "It's time to spin the wheel! Are you R E A D Y ? Of course you are!"
SPIRE1-GREMLIN_WHEEL_GAME.pages.CURSE.de: "Looks like you won a Curse! That's not good. Oh well! Better luck next time!"
SPIRE1-GREMLIN_WHEEL_GAME.pages.REMOVE.d: "Ohh, the power of darkness... Choose a card to remove from your deck!"
SPIRE1-GREMLIN_WHEEL_GAME.pages.REMOVE.o: [Prize!] Remove a card from your deck.
SPIRE1-GREMLIN_WHEEL_GAME.pages.DAMAGE.d: "Uh oh! You lose!" You spot him readying a shiv...
SPIRE1-LAB.title: Lab
SPIRE1-LAB.pages.INITIAL.description: You find yourself in a room filled with racks of test tubes, beakers, flasks, forceps, pinch clamps, stirring rods, tongs, goggles, funnels, pipets, cylinders, condensers, and even a rare spiral tube of glass. Why do you know the name of all these tools? It doesn't matter, you take a look around.
SPIRE1-NLOTH.title: N'loth
SPIRE1-NLOTH.pages.INITIAL.description: An odd creature with a hunched back sprouting several tentacles is scrounging through a pile of trash and debris in front of you. As you approach, he shuffles towards you in a non-threatening manner. "N'loth hungry. Feed N'loth."
SPIRE1-NLOTH.pages.LEAVE.description: You shake your head. N'loth hunches even further and sighs, then scuttles away.
SPIRE1-NOTE_FOR_YOURSELF.title: A Note For Yourself
SPIRE1-NOTE_FOR_YOURSELF.pages.INITIAL.d: You spot a loose brick within a pillar that catches your eye.
SPIRE1-NOTE_FOR_YOURSELF.pages.CHOOSE.de: You find a folded note and a card inside. It reads, "The Heart awaits." This is your handwriting.
SPIRE1-NOTE_FOR_YOURSELF.pages.CHOOSE.op: [Take and Give] Receive !Card! and Store a Card.
SPIRE1-PURIFICATION_SHRINE.title: Purifier
SPIRE1-PURIFICATION_SHRINE.pages.INITIAL: Before you lies an elaborate shrine to a forgotten spirit.
[Pray] Remove a card from your deck.
SPIRE1-PURIFICATION_SHRINE.pages.PRAY.de: As you kneel in reverence, you feel a weight lifted off your shoulders.
SPIRE1-TRANSMOGRIFIER.title: Transmogrifier
SPIRE1-TRANSMOGRIFIER.pages.INITIAL.desc: Before you lies an elaborate shrine to a forgotten spirit.
SPIRE1-TRANSMOGRIFIER.pages.PRAY.descrip: As the power of the shrine flows through you, your mind feels altered.
SPIRE1-UPGRADE_SHRINE.title: Upgrade Shrine
SPIRE1-UPGRADE_SHRINE.pages.INITIAL.desc: Before you lies an elaborate shrine to a forgotten spirit.
SPIRE1-UPGRADE_SHRINE.pages.PRAY.descrip: The shrine's energy flows into you, making you stronger.
SPIRE1-WE_MEET_AGAIN.title: We Meet Again!
SPIRE1-WE_MEET_AGAIN.pages.INITIAL.descr: "We meet again!" A cheery disheveled fellow approaches you gleefully. You do not know this man. "It's me, Ranwid! Have any goods for me today? The usual? A fella like me can't make it alone, you know?" You eye him suspiciously and consider your options...
SPIRE1-WE_MEET_AGAIN.pages.INITIAL.optio: [Give Gold] Lose !Gold! Gold. Obtain a Relic.
SPIRE1-WE_MEET_AGAIN.pages.POTION.descri: "Exquisite! Was feeling parched." Glup glup glup He downs the potion in one go and lets out a satisfied burp. He rummages around his various pockets... "Here, look what I've got for you today! Take it take it!"
SPIRE1-WE_MEET_AGAIN.pages.GOLD.descript: "Magnificent! This will be quite handy if I run into those mask wearing hoodlums again." He rummages around his various pockets... "Here, look what I've got for you today! Take it take it!"
SPIRE1-WE_MEET_AGAIN.pages.CARD.descript: "Exemplary! I shall study this further in my chambers." He rummages around his various pockets... "Here, look what I've got for you today! Take it take it!"
SPIRE1-WE_MEET_AGAIN.pages.ATTACK.descri: " Aaaaagghh!! What a jerk you are sometimes!" He runs away.
SPIRE1-WOMAN_IN_BLUE.title: The Woman in Blue
SPIRE1-WOMAN_IN_BLUE.pages.INITIAL.descr: From the darkness, an arm pulls you into a small shop. As your eyes adjust, you see a pale woman in sharp clothes gesturing towards a wall of potions. "Buy a potion. Now!" she states.
SPIRE1-WOMAN_IN_BLUE.pages.DONE.descript: "Good. Now leave." You exit the shop cautiously.
SPIRE1-WOMAN_IN_BLUE.pages.PUNCHED.descr: WHAM Her gloved fist collides with your face, nearly knocking you off your feet. "Get out before I litter the floor with your guts." You take her word and exit with your guts still safely in your body.
SPIRE1-DRUG_DEALER.pages.JAX.description: "Excellent." The man hands over a dangerous looking syringe filled with a glowing liquid before skulking off into a shadowy alleyway.
SPIRE1-TOMB_RED_MASK.pages.INITIAL.optio: [Offer: !Gold! Gold] Lose all Gold. Obtain a Relic.
SPIRE1-TOMB_RED_MASK.pages.DON_MASK.desc: You don the mask and the tomb starts to flake away... a secret passage! The passage is lined with countless stolen goods and mounds of gold!
SPIRE1-TOMB_RED_MASK.pages.OFFER.descrip: An opening appears in the tomb and out slides a small red mask with a note attached. "Take from others as I have taken from you!"
SPIRE1-FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.INITIAL.opt: [Offer: Golden Idol] Obtain a special relic. Lose Golden Idol.
SPIRE1-MOAI_HEAD.pages.OFFER.description: You jump back a little as the gigantic molars smash down on the idol, smashing it into dust. As the teeth start to rise up again, gold pours forth in a torrent from the opening, flooding you with riches.
SPIRE1-DRUG_DEALER.pages.MUTAGENS.descri: "Marvelous." You quaff the mysterious substance. Immediately, you are invigorated and feel your muscle fibers twitch.
SPIRE1-ACCURSED_BLACKSMITH.pages.INITIAL: [Rummage] Obtain a special Relic. Become Cursed - Pain.
SPIRE1-ACCURSED_BLACKSMITH.pages.RUMMAGE: You decide to see if you can find anything of use. After uncovering tarps, looking through boxes, and checking nooks and crannies, you find a dust covered relic! Taking the relic, you can't shake a sudden feeling of sharp pain as you exit the hut. Maybe you disturbed some sort of spirit?
SPIRE1-BONFIRE.pages.CURSE.description: You toss an offering into the bonfire. However, the spirits aren't happy that you offered a Curse... The card fizzles a meek black smoke. You receive a... something in return.
SPIRE1-FACE_TRADER.pages.TRADE.descripti: "For me? FOR ME? Oh yes.. Yes. Yes.. mmm..." You see one of his arms flicker, and your face is in its hand! Your face has been swapped. "Nice face. Nice face."
